t: This is Cohen House, a private home on Old Church Street in Chelsea, and it's Grade Two star listed. It was designed and built in 1935 and 1936 for the Cohen family. The architects were Erich Mendelsohn and Serge Chermayeff, working with Birkin Haward. Mendelsohn was a German-British architect known for expressive 1920s buildings and for his department stores and cinemas. Chermayeff was a Russian-born architect, designer, educator and writer. Norman Foster, the pioneer of high-tech architecture, is also linked to the house as a designer.
